subject: Not a question, but a resource

messages.author: 448410b8993f8a6a
messages.subject: Not a question, but a resource
parts: Today we discussed non-parametric analyses for count and proportion data, and I wanted to add this resource ("A Robust Procedure for Comparing Multiple Means under Heteroscedasticity in Unbalanced Designs") to the discussion. It appears that the packages multcomp and sandwich (as someone else also mentioned today, thanks) provide options for conducting non-parametric analyses where variances are heteroskedastic, and also allows for all pairwise comparisons or just comparisons to a control (a la Dunnett). Caveat: I have not tried this with my dataset, and not sure how it deals with overdispersion, but this might help with yours!
